PART 1 - scripts/v3_archetype_calibration_probe.py (CPython 3.14, psycopg 3 sync, ruff py314, parameterized SQL only). CLI: --generation-key (required), --max-systems (int, default 200000, hard-capped at 1000000: larger values are rejected), --stride (int >= 1; default: computed so that about max-systems/1000 chunks are sampled evenly across the ordinal range), --statement-timeout-ms (default 60000), --database-url-env (default V3_ARCHETYPE_PROBE_DATABASE_URL — the DSN is read ONLY from that environment variable and never printed), --allow-unpublished (flag; without it the generation must be lifecycle_state PUBLISHED AND be the current v3_meta.current_derived_generation pointer, else exit 3). Behaviour: connect with psycopg (connection.read_only = True and autocommit False so every transaction is READ ONLY; also execute SET statement_timeout from the argument), load the generation row (derived_generation_id, lifecycle_state, generation_key, expected_systems), list chunk ordinals from v3_derived.build_chunk for that generation ordered ascending, choose every stride-th ordinal starting at 0 and stop when the running total of chunk `systems` would exceed max-systems, then for each chosen ordinal call scripts.v3_system_archetype._read_chunk_vectors(connection, generation_id, ordinal) (import the module; do not copy the SQL), run model.fit_all(vectors) and model.summarise(fits) per system, and aggregate WITHOUT storing per-system rows beyond what is needed for quantiles (keep per-archetype score lists as array('h') or lists of ints; 1M ints x 8 is fine). Commit (end) the read-only transaction after each chunk. Output ONE JSON document to stdout, sort_keys=True, with: probe_version 'v3-archetype-calibration-probe-1'; generation {generation_key, derived_generation_id, lifecycle_state, is_current_published_pointer (bool), expected_systems}; sample {chunks_total, chunks_sampled, stride, systems_sampled, max_systems, ordinals_first_last: [first, last]}; coefficients (from v3_system_archetype._coefficients()), archetype_version (model.ARCHETYPE_VERSION), anchors (from _anchors()), code_identity (from v3_system_archetype.code_identity() if it needs only the repo root; otherwise omit and say so); per_archetype: for each key in ARCHETYPE_KEYS {count, score_min, score_p10, score_p50, score_p90, score_max, score_mean (rounded 3), tier_histogram {S,A,B,C,D}, confidence_p10, confidence_p50, confidence_p90}; primary_counts {key: n}; secondary_counts {key: n, 'none': n}; best_tier_histogram {S,A,B,C,D}; archetype_confidence {p10,p50,p90, share_below_0_1}; separation: for the triple (mining_hub, manufacturing_hub, megacomplex): {primary_counts for the three, systems_with_two_or_more_at_tier_B_or_better, systems_with_all_three_at_tier_B_or_better, pairwise_primary_runner_up: {"mining_hub->manufacturing_hub": n, ...} counting, for systems whose primary is X, how often Y is the secondary}; elapsed_seconds; read_only: true; writes_performed: false. Quantiles: nearest-rank on sorted values (define a small helper; no numpy). Exit codes: 0 success; 2 usage/env error (missing DSN env var, bad args); 3 generation not found / not PUBLISHED / not current pointer (unless --allow-unpublished); 4 database error (message without DSN). Never write, never call any lifecycle function, never import the builder's register/build/validate functions.
